description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets published per year, broken down by researcher location categories shown in the legend. The horizontal axis lists years (approximately 2012 through 2022) in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a logarithmic scale with tick marks shown at powers of ten (e.g., 10^0, 10^1, 10^2), indicating values spanning from about 1 up to at least 100. For each year, multiple narrow vertical bars are grouped together, with colors representing locations: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). Early years show only a few bars near the 10^0–10^1 range (e.g., small orange USA bars around 2012–2013 and small blue Other bars around 2013–2015), while later years include more location categories per year and taller bars extending into the 10^1–10^2 range; for example, around 2016–2020 the blue “Other” bars reach into the tens and in some years approach or exceed the 10^2 line, and orange “USA” bars also extend into the tens to near the 10^2 range. In the most recent years (around 2021–2022), multiple colored bars remain present with heights generally in the tens, and there are also lighter, semi-transparent bars visible near the far right that appear to be additional overplotted series without corresponding legend entries. The bars are not sorted by height within each year; they are arranged as grouped bars by year with consistent color coding, and there are no explicit annotations or special emphasis beyond the legend and color scheme.
